notes.title: From Crawlers to Knuckleheads – Growing Snakes with Fists
notes.notes: [h2]From Crawlers to Knuckleheads – Growing [i]Snakes with Fists[/i][/h2][p]When the demo for Snakes with Fists first started, it was just you and a bunch of crawlers. It was fun, but definitely bare-bones.  [/p][p]Then came [i]DreamHack Dallas[/i] and [i]DreamHack Atlanta[/i] — and everything changed. Watching hundreds of people play gave me real-time feedback that shaped the game in huge ways.  [/p][p][/p][h3]New Mechanics from Player Feedback  [/h3][p]Players loved skill-based moments, so we added:  [/p][list][*][p]Perfect Parry – Time it right, deflect the hit, and restore health.  [/p][/*][*][p]Finishing Punch – A flashy knockout on weakened enemies that also heals you.  [/p][/*][/list][p]Both reward timing, strategy, and a little risk-taking.  [/p][p][/p][h3]New Enemies, New Challenges  [/h3][p]No more endless crawler spam. The streets are now full of:  [/p][list][*][p]Knucklehead Bruisers – Hand to hand heavy hitters.  [/p][/*][*][p]Knucklehead Sluggers – Bat-swinging troublemakers.  [/p][/*][*][p]Knucklehead Gunners – Projectile specialists who keep their distance.  [/p][/*][/list][p]Every type changes how you fight — and how you survive.  [/p][p][/p][h3] What’s Next  [/h3][p]The demo’s grown a ton, but we’re just getting started. Currently adding custom character buffs![/p][p]Every conversation, every laugh, and all of the wonderful moments from DreamHack really helped shape [i]Snakes with Fists[/i] into a bigger, weirder, and more fun brawler.  [/p][p]Thanks for playing — and keep the feedback coming!  [/p][p]— Joe  [/p][p]Green Guy Blue Guy[/p][p][/p]
